Download a Single Lichess Game

Source: R/games.R
lic_game.Rd

Retrieves full details of a specific game by its ID.

Usage

lic_game(
  game_id,
  moves = TRUE,
  clocks = TRUE,
  evals = TRUE,
  opening = TRUE,
  token = lic_token()
)

lic_get_game(
  game_id,
  moves = TRUE,
  clocks = TRUE,
  evals = TRUE,
  opening = TRUE,
  token = lic_token()
)

Arguments

game_id

Lichess game ID (e.g. "0tMlsM69").

moves

Logical. Include move notation. Default is TRUE.

clocks

Logical. Include move clock times. Default is TRUE.

evals

Logical. Include Stockfish evaluations. Default is TRUE.

opening

Logical. Include opening details. Default is TRUE.

token

API access token. By default, retrieved via lic_token().

Value

A single-row tibble::tibble containing game details.

Details

Lichess API Endpoint: GET /game/export/{gameId}

Official Documentation: https://lichess.org/api#tag/Games/operation/gamePgn

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
game <- lic_game("0tMlsM69")
}
